name: Dukesell
long_description:
Duke equips ecommerce merchants with the tools they need to participate in agentic commerce, regardless of platform or geography.

Merchants can deploy voice agents that understand customers, recommend products and help process orders in 50+ languages. Duke connects deeply to the merchant’s catalog, inventory, customer history, orders and fulfillment, giving agents the context they need to personalize and complete transactions.

Duke also provides the agent-ready infrastructure that makes merchant products and purchasing flows accessible to external commerce agents, allowing consumers to discover and buy from merchants through the AI tools they already use.

Merchants can connect an existing Shopify store or use Duke directly. Our goal is to make every merchant discoverable, understandable and transactable by agents.

launches.title: Duke: Powering Merchants for Agentic Commerce
launches.tagline: We’re launching Duke to make every ecommerce merchant agent-ready.
launches.body:
**We’re launching Duke to make every ecommerce merchant agent-ready.**

Agentic commerce will fundamentally change how people discover, evaluate and buy products online. Our goal with Duke is to equip merchants, regardless of platform or geography, with what they need to participate in that shift.

We learned the importance of this while building Tendo, a social reselling platform. Human resellers created significant value by building trust, understanding customers and personalizing how they sold. We believe AI agents can deliver that personalization at 10x the scale, while also creating a fundamentally better interface for commerce.

Duke equips merchants with:

* **Voice agents** that understand customers, recommend products and help process orders in 50+ languages
* **Agent-ready integrations** designed to make merchant catalogs and commerce capabilities accessible to consumer agents and platforms such as ChatGPT, Muse and other shopping agents
* **Deep commerce context** across products, inventory, customer history, orders and fulfillment, so agents can personalize and actually complete transactions rather than simply answer questions

Merchants can connect an existing Shopify store or use Duke directly.

Our bet is that agentic commerce is not simply about removing clicks from checkout. The real opportunity is to bring **trust, personalization and a better interface** to online commerce at a scale human sales agents could never reach.

As more consumers delegate discovery and purchasing to AI, every merchant will need to be understandable, discoverable and transactable by agents.

We want Duke to make any merchant, on any platform, anywhere in the world, agent-ready.

**We just launched Duke publicly on social media and would really appreciate the YC community supporting us with a like or repost.**

[X Launch](https://x.com/FelixManfordx1/status/2122375938453160349?a=icS47B1IwofkAJ77Q1k&s=20)
